title: %min - smallest numeric value in an array
purpose: Reduce an array reference to its minimum numeric element.
notes: Folds the whole array; it is not the scalar comparator (that is %minOf in the numeric family).
A whole-number minimum is emitted as an integer (##); a fractional one stays a number (#).

avoid.why: %min reduces an array; a scalar reference resolves to no array and returns ~ instead of the value
